decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The access doorways to the premises shall have a minimum clear width of 900mm, a level surface or ramp between the pavement and the floor and a door handle of not more than 1m above ground level.
Condition : 3 - The use hereby permitted shall not be open to customers outside the following times - 11:00 a.m. and 11:00 p.m..
Condition : 5 - The two parking spaces shown on the plans hereby approved at the back of the two units shall be retained permanently.

Condition : 6 - The extract system shall comprise of a three-stage system to include a grease, pre-and carbon filter. The duct as shown on the approved plans, shall terminate one metre above the eaves or one metre above any openable windows of adjacent premises whichever is the higher.The duct shall terminate pointing upwards. A cowl shall be omitted and lightweight flaps or other covers, which open when the system is powered, should be fitted. The system shall be routinely serviced.The duct shall not exceed the dimensions shown on the submitted plans and shall not be located other than as shown on the plans without the prior written approval of the Local Planning Authority, obtained through submission of a planning permission application.

Condition : 7 - The extract system shall not cause an increase in background noise level (BNL) in the vicinity. When the system is operating at a maximum, the noise levels shall be 10bB(A) lower than the BNL. To achieve this the following measures shall be adopted.1.	The fan unit and filters shall be located within the building, or if it is to be located outside the building, they shall be housed within an acoustic enclosure.2.	Silencers shall be provided to one or both sides of the fan as necessary.3.	Ducting shall be configured to minimise turbulent air flow with no acute bends or duct constrictions.4.	Ducting shall be circular.5.	The fan shall be isolated from inlet and outlet ducting using flexible couplings.6.	The fan shall be mounted using anti-vibration mounts. 7.	The ducting shall be isolated from the building structure using anti-vibration mountings and a packing material where it passes through any solid structure.
Condition : 8 - The extraction and noise control systems as detailed in Conditions 5 and 6 above shall be fully implemented before the use is commenced.
description: Sub-division of the existing ground floor unit into two units comprising one to be used for fast food (takeaway) (A5) purposes and one for retail purposes (A1)
